article.title: Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage
article.content: Whoever, dishonestly or with a fraudulent intention, goes through the ceremony of being married, knowing that he is not thereby lawfully married, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
article.html:
83Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage

Section 83 · Chapter V · Of offences relating to marriage

Whoever, dishonestly or with a fraudulent intention, goes through the ceremony of being married, knowing that he is not thereby lawfully married, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to seven years, and shall also be liable to fine.
